```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# TF enrichment via GSEA (cross-check against script 05 mitch)
# Key difference from script 05:
# - Uses full ranked PC1/PC2 gene list (no discrete cutoff)
# - Gene sets from Mahendrawada et al. 2025 Tables A/C/E
# - fgsea package rather than mitch
# - Produces NES-based output directly comparable to
#   script 03 (GO GSEA) for cross-method consistency
# ---------------------------------------------------------

project_dir <- file.path(path.expand("~"), "Downloads", "AC_combined_analysis", "Adriana_analysis")
tables_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures")
output_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "output_tables")

dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fgsea)

select <- dplyr::select

# install fgsea if needed (Bioconductor)
if (!requireNamespace("fgsea", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("fgsea")
}
```

```{r establish-pc-directions}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Establish biological direction of PC1 and PC2 by correlating
# sample-level PC scores with mean cell volume.
#
# PC1 vs cell volume: Spearman r = -0.216
#   -> PC1 reflects TOR/PKA signalling state, not cell size
#   -> Positive NES (high PC1) = active TOR/PKA signalling
#   -> Negative NES (low PC1)  = TOR/PKA inhibited
#
# PC2 vs cell volume: Spearman r = +0.795
#   -> PC2 is the primary cell size axis
#   -> Positive NES (high PC2) = genes upregulated in large cells
#   -> Negative NES (low PC2)  = genes upregulated in small cells
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_samples <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_samples_AC.txt"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE)

pc_vol_cor <- pca_samples %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_cell_volume)) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_PC1_vol = cor(PC1, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman"),
    cor_PC2_vol = cor(PC2, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman")
  )

cat("PC1 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3), "\n")
cat("PC2 vs cell volume (Spearman r):", round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3), "\n")

pc1_subtitle <- paste0(
  "PC1 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
  round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC1_vol, 3),
  "  |  PC1 reflects TOR/PKA signalling state, not cell size"
)

pc2_subtitle <- paste0(
  "PC2 vs cell volume: Spearman r = ",
  round(pc_vol_cor$cor_PC2_vol, 3),
  "  |  PC2 is the primary cell size axis"
)
```

```{r load-pca}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PC1/PC2 gene scores - ranked lists for GSEA input
# Same approach as script 03 (GO GSEA)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

make_ranked_list <- function(df, pc_col) {
  df %>%
    select(gene_id, all_of(pc_col)) %>%
    arrange(desc(.data[[pc_col]])) %>%
    deframe()
}

ranked_pc1 <- make_ranked_list(pca_genes, "PC1")
ranked_pc2 <- make_ranked_list(pca_genes, "PC2")

cat("PC1 ranked list:", length(ranked_pc1), "genes\n")
cat("PC2 ranked list:", length(ranked_pc2), "genes\n")
```

```{r build-tf-genesets}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# TF gene sets from Mahendrawada et al. 2025 Supp Table 3
# Three collections, as per scripts 05 and 07:
#   Table A: binding (TF binds gene = 1)
#   Table C: activated (log2FC < 0) / repressed (log2FC > 0)
#            on TF depletion
#   Table E: direct targets (bound + regulated)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
supp_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3 updated.xlsx")
table_a   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3a")
table_c   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3c")
table_e   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3e")

# Table A: binding gene sets
tf_cols_a     <- colnames(table_a)[-1]
genesets_tf_a <- map(tf_cols_a, ~table_a %>%
                       filter(.data[[.x]] == 1) %>%
                       pull(gene_id)) %>%
  set_names(paste0(tf_cols_a, "_bound")) %>%
  keep(~length(.x) >= 5)

# Table C: activated and repressed gene sets
tf_cols_c    <- setdiff(colnames(table_c), c("gene_id", "Kmeans_clusters"))
table_c_long <- table_c %>%
  select(gene_id, all_of(tf_cols_c)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

genesets_c_act <- table_c_long %>%
  filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_activated"))

genesets_c_rep <- table_c_long %>%
  filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_repressed"))

genesets_tf_c <- c(genesets_c_act, genesets_c_rep)

# Table E: direct targets
tf_cols_e    <- colnames(table_e)[-1]
table_e_long <- table_e %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

genesets_e_act <- table_e_long %>%
  filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_direct_activated"))

genesets_e_rep <- table_e_long %>%
  filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe() %>%
  set_names(paste0(names(.), "_direct_repressed"))

genesets_tf_e <- c(genesets_e_act, genesets_e_rep)

cat("TF gene sets - Table A:", length(genesets_tf_a),
    "| Table C:", length(genesets_tf_c),
    "| Table E:", length(genesets_tf_e), "\n")
```

```{r check-overlap}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity check: gene ID overlap between PCA and TF tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_ids <- names(ranked_pc1)
cat("Genes in PCA:", length(pca_ids), "\n")
cat("PCA genes in Table A targets:", length(intersect(pca_ids, unlist(genesets_tf_a))), "\n")
cat("PCA genes in Table C targets:", length(intersect(pca_ids, unlist(genesets_tf_c))), "\n")
cat("PCA genes in Table E targets:", length(intersect(pca_ids, unlist(genesets_tf_e))), "\n")
```

```{r run-gsea-function}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# fgsea wrapper - runs GSEA for one ranked list and one
# collection of gene sets, returns tidy results table.
# minSize/maxSize filter gene sets by size, matching
# the minGSSize used in scripts 03 and 05.
# nPermSimple = 1000 is standard; seed for reproducibility.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
run_fgsea <- function(ranked_list, genesets, label,
                      min_size = 5, max_size = 500,
                      n_perm = 1000) {
  set.seed(42)
  cat("Running GSEA:", label, "\n")

  result <- fgsea(
    pathways  = genesets,
    stats     = ranked_list,
    minSize   = min_size,
    maxSize   = max_size,
    nPermSimple = n_perm
  ) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    arrange(padj)

  n_sig <- sum(result$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(" ", nrow(result), "sets tested |", n_sig,
      "significant (FDR < 0.05)\n")
  result
}
```

```{r run-all}
# Run GSEA for PC1 and PC2 across all three TF table collections
gsea_tf_a_pc1 <- run_fgsea(ranked_pc1, genesets_tf_a, "PC1 - Table A")
gsea_tf_a_pc2 <- run_fgsea(ranked_pc2, genesets_tf_a, "PC2 - Table A")

gsea_tf_c_pc1 <- run_fgsea(ranked_pc1, genesets_tf_c, "PC1 - Table C")
gsea_tf_c_pc2 <- run_fgsea(ranked_pc2, genesets_tf_c, "PC2 - Table C")

gsea_tf_e_pc1 <- run_fgsea(ranked_pc1, genesets_tf_e, "PC1 - Table E")
gsea_tf_e_pc2 <- run_fgsea(ranked_pc2, genesets_tf_e, "PC2 - Table E")
```

```{r plot-function}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# NES dot plot: top 20 significant TF sets by absolute NES,
# coloured by direction - matching script 03 GO GSEA format
# for direct cross-method comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_tf_gsea <- function(result, title, subtitle = NULL, n_top = 20) {
  sig <- result %>% filter(padj < 0.05)

  if (nrow(sig) == 0) {
    cat("No significant results for:", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df_top <- sig %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(NES))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    mutate(
      label = if_else(nchar(pathway) > 45,
                      str_trunc(pathway, 45, ellipsis = "..."),
                      pathway),
      label = fct_reorder(label, NES),
      direction = if_else(NES > 0,
                          "Positive NES\n(high PC score)",
                          "Negative NES\n(low PC score)")
    )

  ggplot(df_top, aes(x = NES, y = label,
                     size = size, color = direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Positive NES\n(high PC score)" = "#d6604d",
      "Negative NES\n(low PC score)"  = "#4393c3"
    )) +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Normalised Enrichment Score (NES)",
      y = NULL,
      size  = "Gene set size",
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey40")
    )
}
```

```{r plots-table-a, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
plot_tf_gsea(gsea_tf_a_pc1, "TF enrichment GSEA - Table A binding, PC1",
             subtitle = pc1_subtitle)
plot_tf_gsea(gsea_tf_a_pc2, "TF enrichment GSEA - Table A binding, PC2",
             subtitle = pc2_subtitle)
```

```{r plots-table-c, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
plot_tf_gsea(gsea_tf_c_pc1, "TF enrichment GSEA - Table C act/rep, PC1",
             subtitle = pc1_subtitle)
plot_tf_gsea(gsea_tf_c_pc2, "TF enrichment GSEA - Table C act/rep, PC2",
             subtitle = pc2_subtitle)
```

```{r plots-table-e, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
plot_tf_gsea(gsea_tf_e_pc1, "TF enrichment GSEA - Table E direct targets, PC1",
             subtitle = pc1_subtitle)
plot_tf_gsea(gsea_tf_e_pc2, "TF enrichment GSEA - Table E direct targets, PC2",
             subtitle = pc2_subtitle)
```

```{r save-outputs}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Save results tables (leadingEdge column is a list -
# convert to semicolon-separated string for TSV export)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
flatten_leading_edge <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(leadingEdge = map_chr(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";"))
}

write_tsv(flatten_leading_edge(gsea_tf_a_pc1),
          file.path(output_dir, "tf_gsea_tableA_pc1.txt"))
write_tsv(flatten_leading_edge(gsea_tf_a_pc2),
          file.path(output_dir, "tf_gsea_tableA_pc2.txt"))
write_tsv(flatten_leading_edge(gsea_tf_c_pc1),
          file.path(output_dir, "tf_gsea_tableC_pc1.txt"))
write_tsv(flatten_leading_edge(gsea_tf_c_pc2),
          file.path(output_dir, "tf_gsea_tableC_pc2.txt"))
write_tsv(flatten_leading_edge(gsea_tf_e_pc1),
          file.path(output_dir, "tf_gsea_tableE_pc1.txt"))
write_tsv(flatten_leading_edge(gsea_tf_e_pc2),
          file.path(output_dir, "tf_gsea_tableE_pc2.txt"))

# Save figures
plot_pairs <- list(
  list(gsea_tf_a_pc1, "tf_gsea_tableA_pc1.png", "Table A binding, PC1",    pc1_subtitle),
  list(gsea_tf_a_pc2, "tf_gsea_tableA_pc2.png", "Table A binding, PC2",    pc2_subtitle),
  list(gsea_tf_c_pc1, "tf_gsea_tableC_pc1.png", "Table C act/rep, PC1",    pc1_subtitle),
  list(gsea_tf_c_pc2, "tf_gsea_tableC_pc2.png", "Table C act/rep, PC2",    pc2_subtitle),
  list(gsea_tf_e_pc1, "tf_gsea_tableE_pc1.png", "Table E direct, PC1",     pc1_subtitle),
  list(gsea_tf_e_pc2, "tf_gsea_tableE_pc2.png", "Table E direct, PC2",     pc2_subtitle)
)

for (pp in plot_pairs) {
  p <- plot_tf_gsea(pp[[1]],
                    paste("TF enrichment GSEA -", pp[[3]]),
                    subtitle = pp[[4]])
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, pp[[2]]),
           plot = p, width = 10, height = 9)
  }
}

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
